answer: New identities start in a lagoon where they can only trade with other newcomers for five epochs. Each posts a 40-token bond and works along a public thread of tasks open to audit; every epoch, auditors re-run one task from each thread at random. A failed check burns that identity's bond, and a ripple runs outward: any other identity funded from the same wallet thread loses its bond too, so one bad job kills a farmer's whole cluster. Leaving the lagoon needs 25 audited tasks, about 10 hours each, so 100 fakes cost 1,000 hours and 4,000 tokens at risk.
